title: Bigger Model or Bigger Table? How Much Backbone a Chorus N-gram Module Replaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.34725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We ask how much of a transformer's backbone the Chorus N-gram module replaces. Chorus adds hashed tables of token bigrams and trigrams to its input and attention. We train models of 16M to 349M parameters on 1.34 billion tokens of Polish printed before 1918 and find the size of a plain model with the same held-out loss. A separate learning-rate search for each kind of model cuts Chorus's gain at 47M by about a third. With tables about as large as the backbone, Chorus then matches a plain model 1.34 times its size at 16M and 1.16 to 1.20 times from 107M to 349M. With these tables, each added parameter replaces at most 0.31 backbone parameters. Chorus trains slower than a plain model of its size and faster than one of the same loss. On a fact quiz the two differ about as much as two seeds of one model. The results rest on one corpus, one 8,000-token vocabulary and a fifth of an epoch.

translated_title: 更大的模型还是更大的表格？Chorus N-gram 模块能替代多少主干网络
translated_abstract: 我们探究了 Chorus N-gram 模块能在多大程度上替代 transformer 的主干网络。Chorus 在其输入和注意力机制中加入了基于哈希表存储的词元二元组（bigram）和三元组（trigram）。我们在 13.4 亿词元的 1918 年之前印刷的波兰语文本上训练了 1600 万至 3.49 亿参数的模型，并找出具有相同留出集损失的普通模型所需的规模。针对每种模型分别进行独立的学习率搜索后，Chorus 在 47M 规模下的收益减少了约三分之一。当查找表规模与主干网络大致相当时，Chorus 在 16M 规模下可以匹敌 1.34 倍于其规模的普通模型，在 107M 至 349M 规模下可以匹敌 1.16 至 1.20 倍于其规模的普通模型。使用这些表格时，每个新增参数最多只能替代 0.31 个主干网络参数。Chorus 的训练速度比同等规模的普通模型慢，但比达到相同损失的普通模型快。在事实问答测验上，两者的差异大约相当于同一模型在不同随机种子下的差异。这些结果基于单一语料库、一个 8000 词元的词表以及仅五分之一个训练周期。
tldr: 该论文通过在 13.4 亿波兰语词元上训练 16M 至 349M 参数的模型，量化了 Chorus N-gram 哈希表模块对 transformer 主干网络的替代作用：当查找表与主干网络规模相当时，每个新增参数最多可替代 0.31 个主干参数，使模型能够以较小规模匹敌 1.16 至 1.34 倍大小的普通模型。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies how much of a transformer's backbone the Chorus N-gram hashed-table module replaces, showing that with tables as large as the backbone, each added parameter substitutes at most 0.31 backbone parameters, enabling smaller models to match plain models 1.16–1.34 times their size.
